item.text:
**7B.5**
Verdict: mixed, leaning negative.

Search gap: I did not find strong 2024 evidence that AMLO filled formal cabinet posts with literal relatives or donors. The sharper negative evidence is instead the militarization of government functions, the weakening of independent appointment/oversight bodies, and repeated reliance on trusted political-security blocs.

- **Claudia Sheinbaum ya tiene secretario de Hacienda; Ramírez de la O se queda** - El Financiero, 2024-06-03. [URL](https://www.elfinanciero.com.mx/elecciones-mexico-2024/2024/06/03/claudia-sheinbaum-nombra-a-rogelio-ramirez-de-la-o-como-secretario-de-hacienda-y-credito-publico-se-queda/) Summary: AMLO’s finance minister Rogelio Ramírez de la O, described as the continuity choice, remained in place because he was seen as credible and stabilizing. This is the clearest evidence that AMLO kept at least one major portfolio in technocratic hands. IDs: `7B.5`
- **IMSS said 2024 would be the biggest year for graduating and hiring specialists** - IMSS, 2024-02-27. [URL](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202402/095) Summary: IMSS said more than 25,000 IMSS-Bienestar health workers were regularized into permanent posts, which points to professional staffing rather than patronage hiring. IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.3`
- **The 2024 rules of operation define IMSS-Bienestar** - Diario Oficial de la Federación / IMSS, 2024. [URL](https://sidof.segob.gob.mx/notas/docFuente/5713366) Summary: The health system was formalized through specific medical, finance, and administration units and framed as a constitutional-rights service system, which is evidence of institution-building with professional administration. IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.3`
- **Entrega directa de programas para el bienestar abate la corrupción** - Programas para el Bienestar, 2024-10-17. [URL](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/entrega-directa-de-programas-para-el-bienestar-abate-la-corrupcion/) Summary: The government said direct deposits to Banco del Bienestar cards eliminated intermediaries and commissions, which is a concrete anti-patronage design rather than a loyalty machine. IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.4`
- **Gobierno federal presenta caso de evasion fiscal de Totalplay** - Presidencia de México, 2024-03-15. [URL](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-federal-presenta-caso-de-evasion-fiscal-de-totalplay-debe-mas-de-mil-500-millones-de-pesos-al-sat/) Summary: The administration publicly pursued a tax-evasion case against a politically connected company, evidence against routine favoritism toward insiders. IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.4`
- **Gobierno de México mantiene demanda en Florida para recuperar 634 mdd por trama de corrupción de García Luna** - Presidencia de México, 2024-02-16. [URL](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-de-mexico-mantiene-demanda-en-florida-para-recuperar-634-mdd-por-trama-de-corrupcion-de-garcia-luna/) Summary: AMLO’s government kept asset-recovery litigation alive in a major corruption case, which is at least some evidence of using state power against corruption rather than private enrichment. IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.4`
- **Fuerzas armadas, fundamentales para la transformación del país: AMLO** - La Jornada, 2024-04-02. [URL](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2024/04/02/politica/fuerzas-armadas-fundamentales-para-la-transformacion-del-pais-amlo-1407) Summary: AMLO said he was not mistaken in appointing Sandoval and Ojeda and emphasized military loyalty to him and the people. That is direct evidence of favoring trusted loyalists in a core security institution. IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.3`
- **Presidente reconoce a Fuerzas Armadas por pacificar al país; el pueblo confía en su labor, afirma** - Presidencia de México, 2024-05-06. [URL](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presidente-reconoce-a-fuerzas-armadas-por-pacificar-al-pais-el-pueblo-confia-en-su-labor-afirma/) Summary: AMLO described the armed forces as pillars of the state and as central to growth and security, reinforcing his reliance on a loyal security bloc for governing capacity. IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.3`
- **Mexico's outgoing President expanded military remit** - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-09-06. [URL](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-incoming-president-announces-picks-for-military-leadership-3605930) Summary: Reuters noted that under AMLO the military’s remit expanded to building infrastructure and running a state bank, airline, and tourist train. That is strong evidence of a trust network centered on the armed forces rather than ordinary civilian professionals. IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.3`
- **Mexico: Proposed Constitutional Changes Threaten Rights** - Human Rights Watch, 2024-08-30. [URL](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/30/mexico-proposed-constitutional-changes-threaten-rights) Summary: HRW said the proposed reforms would replace judicial appointments with elections, permanently expand military control over civilian law enforcement, and abolish the transparency watchdog. That points toward weakening merit-based staffing and strengthening political-loyalist control. IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.3`
- **World Report 2024: Mexico** - Human Rights Watch, 2024. [URL](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) Summary: HRW said AMLO transferred hundreds of government tasks to the military and, with his party, blocked INAI appointments, leaving the transparency body unable to function normally. This is direct evidence of sidelining independent professionals when they constrain power. IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.3`
- **AMLO dice que su hijo Gonzalo “no va a trabajar en el gobierno”** - El Universal, 2024-07-05. [URL](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/amlo-dice-que-su-hijo-gonzalo-no-va-a-trabajar-en-el-gobierno-tras-reunirse-con-sheinbaum/) Summary: AMLO said his son was only an honorary advisor on the Interoceanic project and would not work in government, which is limited counterevidence against outright family staffing. It is self-serving and not independently audited, but it does cut against a simple nepotism claim. IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.3`

Bottom line: AMLO does have meaningful evidence of technocratic staffing in finance and health, but the stronger pattern in 2024 is the use of the military and party-controlled institutions as loyal governing instruments, plus weakening of independent appointment and oversight filters.
